4461549.name: Chabad Young Professionals Portland & Chabad Northwest Portland
4461549.note: COLlive, 6 Mar 2020 ('New Shluchim Begin Work With Young Adults in Portland'): 'Chabad of Oregon announces the opening of a full-time Chabad Young Professionals Chapter located in Portland's Northwest District under the leadership of Rabbi Meir and Sheina Posner'; before them 'Rabbi Chayim and Simi Mishulovin directed Chabad's Young Professional programming in Portland for the past 15 years.' Medium: its chabad.org listing went up 14 Aug 2019, before the announcement, so the year is that first mention.

1351834.name: Jewish Oasis - Chabad
1351834.note: No founding year found yet. Its chabad.org listing went up 2010-11-24, so it existed by then. COLlive, 6 Mar 2020 (https://collive.com/new-shluchim-to-young-adults-in-portland/): 'Rabbi Chayim and Simi Mishulovin directed Chabad's Young Professional programming in Portland for the past 15 years' (so from about 2005); Lubavitch.com (20 Feb 2024, Lamplighters ep. 42) calls the Jewish Oasis their 'innovative storefront/shmooze center', with no year. Director: Chayim Eliyohu Mishulovin.

5609506.name: Chabad on Campus SW Portland
5609506.note: COLlive, 21 Dec 2022 ('New Shluchim to Portland Colleges'): 'Rabbi Eliyahu and Chaya Citron (nee Turk) and their daughter Leah recently moved to Portland, Oregon to establish Chabad on Campus SW Portland', appointed by Rabbi Moshe Wilhelm; 'The main focus, however, will be on Lewis and Clark College.' Its chabad.org listing went up 11 Nov 2022.

6671612.name: Chabad on Call NorthEast Portland
6671612.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024 ('Chabad Responds to Tragedy by Expanding Global Outreach: 100 New Centers To Be Established'): Keren Hashluchim seed funding 'for one hundred new Chabad centers in underserved areas'; among 'The Fifty New Shluchim': 'Rabbi Eliyahu and Chani Elyovics in Portland, OR' (under CKids). Its chabad.org listing went up 22 Nov 2024.
